title: Social Protection in Later Life and Healthcare Utilization in India
text: This page holds the replication code and the tables for a study of how pension receipt (old age, widow and Annapurna pensions) is related to outpatient and inpatient healthcare use among Indians aged 60-100, using LASI Wave 1.
